items.a: Absolutely. My portfolio is available on this site and on Instagram (@massishoots). I also offer a free 30-minute discovery call to discuss your project and show you examples similar to your brief.

The deposit is non-refundable for cancellations less than 14 days out. For early cancellations, I generally offer a free date change. Life happens — I always adapt with flexibility and respect.

hero.name: Massi Bena.
hero.subtitle: Engineer by training. Filmmaker by vocation.
hero.desc3: Massi does both — with the same rigor and the same passion.

story.label: — The story
story.p1: Massi grew up with two obsessions: understanding how things work and capturing the beauty of the world around him. A software engineer by training, he always had a camera in his hands — not out of obligation, but because it was natural.
story.p2: What started as a pure passion — photographing, filming, observing — gradually transformed into something bigger. Projects multiplied. Clients arrived. And Massi realized his technical background was no accident: it gave him a unique way of seeing and building images.
story.quote: "It's not just photography. It's visual engineering."
story.p3a: Today, Massishoots is the result of this dual expertise.
story.p3b: The engineer's rigor. The artist's sensitivity.
story.p3c: At the service of brands that want an image worthy of their ambitions.

values.v1text: Every project is planned, structured and executed with precision. No improvisation — a clear vision from start to delivery.
values.v2text: We don't do this work to fill a calendar. We do it because every project is a new opportunity to create something exceptional.
values.v3text: A beautiful visual that doesn't perform is a failure. What matters is the impact the content has on your brand and your clients.

why.heading: Why we don't publish fixed pricing.
why.a1text: An entrepreneur just starting out doesn't have the same needs as an agency trying to dominate their market. We build an offer that matches exactly where you are — and where you want to go.
why.a2title: Because the best content is planned.
why.a2text: Before quoting anything, we take 30 minutes to understand your vision, your audience and your goals. That's what makes the difference between content and content that performs.
why.a3title: Because you deserve a real conversation.
why.a3text: Not an automated form. Not a generic PDF. A direct call with Massi to define together what will move your brand forward.
